resources.title: Data Pipeline Explained: The Warehouse Analogy
resources.description: A one-page diagram walking the full modern data pipeline — object storage as the loading dock, Spark as the processing area, Snowflake as the organized storage shelves, and Power BI/SQL as the analysts querying it — with a glossary of bucket, object, folder, stage, and table (Snowflake's own stage/table vocabulary).

resources.title: Medallion Architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold)
resources.description: Bronze/Silver/Gold layer reference diagram showing what each layer holds, who uses it, and why the layered pattern exists — data quality, auditability, reusability, scalability, and governance. The same layering dbt's staging/intermediate/marts convention is built on.

resources.title: The Amazon Fulfillment Center Analogy for Spark
resources.description: A full-page reference on how distributed query processing works — clusters, executors, partitions, the query plan, narrow vs. wide operations, joins, caching, and reading an execution plan. The same concepts Snowflake's own query profiler visualizes under a different name.

resources.title: Why Object Storage Still Matters After Data Is in Snowflake
resources.description: Explains why raw files stay in cheap object storage even after they've been loaded into Snowflake — reprocessing, audit/compliance, lineage, replay for new systems, and cost — with the full pipeline shown end to end, including Snowflake's own external/internal stage model.
